rationale: After 63 minutes in the trade and reaching a maximum excursion around $26.70, upward momentum has stalled well short of the $26.80 target. The latest 1-minute bar broke down through local support at $26.65 and pushed price below the 5-minute 9-EMA ($26.63), invalidating the short-term momentum structure that supported the entry. Closing here locks in a modest gain and protects the tight remaining daily loss budget from a full round-trip toward VWAP.
